model_annotation: This infographic presents three donut charts illustrating the distribution of enterprises, employment, and turnover across four economic sectors—Industry, Construction, Trade, and Other Services—in 2021, based on NACE Rev. 2 classification. The first chart, “NUMBER OF ENTERPRISES,” shows Industry dominating with 61% (19.0 million), followed by Trade at 19% (5.9 million), Construction at 12% (3.7 million), and Other Services at 8% (2.4 million). The second chart, “NUMBER OF PERSONS EMPLOYED,” is similarly led by Industry at 51% (80.2 million), with Trade at 19% (29.5 million), Construction at 21% (33.0 million), and Other Services at 9% (13.4 million). The third chart, “TURNOVER,” shows Industry contributing 31% (9.8 trillion), Trade also contributing 31% (9.9 trillion), Construction at 33% (10.6 trillion), and Other Services at 6% (1.9 trillion). All charts include a legend identifying the color coding for each sector, and each segment is labeled with its percentage and absolute value. The segments are visually arranged in descending order of size within each chart, with Industry consistently occupying the largest share across all three metrics.
